description: This file defines a base activity class named SampleActivityBase that extends FragmentActivity. It includes lifecycle management with overridden onCreate and onStart methods, and sets up logging infrastructure using LogWrapper and Log classes.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class for sample applications, handling common initialization and logging setup.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created; currently calls the superclass implementation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity becomes visible; calls initializeLogging.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging using LogWrapper and Log classes, and logs a 'Ready' message.
